description: Which of the 185 indexed EU acts have a new consolidated version since a date, and which amendments apply from a future date: act, the date it applies from, the EUR-Lex link to that consolidated version, practice area. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
